text: The steps of an import: the document, the run, the questions, the review and the apply. You can go back to any step you have reached.
The document: Excel, Word, PDF or text. Nothing is sent anywhere but to the assistant you choose below.
Optional: the profile, the name of the mapping and the two JSON Schemas. Left empty, the assistant proposes them and asks about what it cannot tell.
Start: a short document is read in one run, a long one in batches.
